comment: Written BEFORE the check (the W discipline). The rows are zing's ledger (v07/q_cases.json); a case may carry its own. f01-f04 are zing's own questions (q02, q08, q03, q10) with their answers, asked of a sentence that declares its records: the check must change no answer. f05, f06, f12 and f14 are lawful and say what the check does NOT refuse; f07-f11 and f13 are the new refusals, marked haro_only: zing reads a missing field as missing and answers no rows. All 25 of zing's pinned questions are asked again, unchanged, on tontine.z by stage 10. f16, f17, f18, f19 and the speaks fragments were added AFTER the check was written, found by the plants (a computed name leaking between flows, an entity leaking between flows, the check run only against rows, the language words dropped): said so here, not silently.

cases.name: zing's q02 on a flow whose records are declared: the same four rows, the check changes no answer

cases.query: SELECT * FROM collect WHERE amount >= 7500 AND round = 2
cases.name: zing's q08, declared

cases.query: SELECT * FROM collect ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1
cases.name: zing's q03, declared: ORDER BY a declared field

cases.query: SELECT * FROM collect WHERE round = 1 ORDER BY member DESC
cases.name: zing's q10, declared: WHERE and ORDER BY together
a field the entity declares and the rows lack is lawful, and matches nothing: a declared field is not a field every row has

cases.query: SELECT * FROM collect ORDER BY member.first
cases.name: a dotted name is judged by its head: member is declared, so member.first is lawful, and orders by what the rows hold (nothing: their own order)

cases.refusal: WHERE names 'ammount', which collect does not declare (its fields: id, member, amount, round, status)
cases.speaks: A question names only the fields its flow's records declare
cases.name: a typo in WHERE: refused before the question runs, naming the field, the flow and what it has

cases.query: SELECT * FROM collect WHERE round = 1 AND nope CONTAINS "x"
cases.refusal: WHERE names 'nope', which collect does not declare
cases.name: an undeclared field deep in a WHERE, beside a declared one

cases.query: SELECT * FROM collect ORDER BY nope
cases.refusal: ORDER BY names 'nope', which collect does not declare (its fields: id, member, amount, round, status)
cases.speaks: A question names only the fields its flow's records declare
cases.name: ORDER BY an undeclared field

cases.refusal: WHERE names 'nope', which collect does not declare
cases.name: an aggregate names a field too

cases.query: SELECT * FROM collect ORDER BY nope.sub
cases.refusal: ORDER BY names 'nope', which collect does not declare
cases.name: a dotted name whose head is not declared is refused by its head
a name a step of the flow COMPUTEs is a field of its records, though no entity declares it

cases.refusal: WHERE names 'total', which indice does not declare (its fields: reponses, score)
cases.name: the fields of a flow are its entity's and what its steps compute, and no others
a flow that writes no RECORDS is not field-checked: zing's reading stands, a missing field is missing, and no rows match

cases.refusal: WHERE names 'score', which collect does not declare (its fields: id, member, amount, round, status)
cases.name: a name another flow's step computes is that flow's field and not this one's

cases.refusal: WHERE names 'amount', which indice does not declare (its fields: reponses, score)
cases.name: a field of another flow's entity is not this flow's

cases.refusal: WHERE names 'ammount', which collect does not declare
cases.name: refused before the question runs: with no row to run it on, a typo is still refused
a dotted name is judged by its head in a WHERE too: member is declared, so member.first is lawful, and reads as missing

cases.query: SELECT * FROM collect WHERE round = 1 ORDER BY amount LIMIT 0
cases.name: LIMIT 0 on declared fields: unchanged
